comment: How a bot-protection challenge is recognised when its status code does not say so. A challenge answered with 503 is not a broken server and one answered with 200 is not content: both are the site refusing a crawler, and the fix is an allowlist, not a server repair. The header is set by the vendor on the challenge response itself. Markers are vendor strings that change, which is why they live here and not in code; on a 200 a marker only counts on a short page, because real pages embed captcha widgets.
